title: Schedule Ads by Deadline
real_world_story: An advertising platform receives several advertisements, each with a deadline and revenue. Every advertisement requires one time slot to display, and an advertisement earns revenue only if it is scheduled on or before its deadline.

real_world_connection.algorithm_represents: Scheduling profitable advertisements before their deadlines

problem_statement: Given N advertisements, each with a deadline and revenue, schedule the advertisements so that at most one advertisement occupies each time slot and every selected advertisement is completed by its deadline. Maximize the total revenue.
task: Find the maximum revenue that can be earned by scheduling advertisements before their deadlines.
input_format: The first line contains an integer N. The second line contains N integers representing advertisement deadlines. The third line contains N integers representing advertisement revenues.
output_format: Print the maximum total revenue that can be earned.

examples.explanation: Schedule the advertisements with revenues 100, 27, and 15 in slots 2, 1, and 3 respectively. The maximum revenue is 100 + 27 + 15 = 142.
The advertisements with revenues 50 and 40 can be scheduled in slots 1 and 2, giving a maximum revenue of 90.

expected_algorithm.name: Job Sequencing with Deadlines
expected_algorithm.reason: Sorting advertisements by revenue and assigning each selected advertisement to the latest available slot before its deadline maximizes total revenue.

hint: Pair every advertisement with its deadline and revenue.
Sort advertisements by revenue in descending order.
For each advertisement, try to place it in the latest available slot before its deadline.
real_world_takeaway: Job sequencing helps advertising platforms maximize revenue when advertisements have deadlines and each slot can display only one advertisement.
